name: GLONASS Precise Ephemeris (IAC SP3) Data Source
description: Executable data-source: pulls an IAC GLONASS precise ephemeris (SP3-d) over HTTP on a timer, emits a schema-exact SDS OEM record per GLONASS satellite (frame/time preserved AS DECLARED in the SP3 header, position-only), and signs + publishes a PNM pointer.

timers.description: Periodic GLONASS IAC SP3 pull (default every 12h; IAC regenerates its precise products ~daily — one SP3 file, per-pull record churn bounded by objectCap).

methods.description: Fetches an IAC GLONASS precise ephemeris (SP3-d) over HTTP, emits a schema-exact SDS OEM record per GLONASS satellite, signs a PNM, and publishes it.

outputPorts.description: Signed PNM pointer published for each pulled + stored GLONASS ephemeris record.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Signed PNM pointer for each published pull record.

methods.displayName: Fetch + parse operator ephemeris and emit $OEM (OD-flow guest-link)
methods.description: Fetches the provider catalog via the host http connector (ps::http_get), parses to SDS $OEM in-memory, and emits one $OEM aligned-binary frame per object on the oem port. Nothing stored/signed/published.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional node CONFIG (endpoints/target/objectCap); default provider endpoints otherwise.
SDS $OEM ephemeris (aligned-binary), one per operator object. Consumed in-memory by analysis/od.fit; never stored.
